narrative: Phishing email delivered Invoice_June_2026.docm to acct.jlee on WIN-ACCT-07. The macro spawned an encoded PowerShell download cradle that pulled a second-stage payload (svchost_helper.exe) from C2 cdn-update-sync.example.net / 203.0.113.45. The implant established persistence via an HKCU Run key and a 10-minute scheduled task (masquerading as OneDriveSync), dumped LSASS via comsvcs.dll MiniDump for credential access, beaconed to C2, and began lateral movement to FILE-SRV-02 over SMB.
decoy: An internet-sourced failed-logon burst from 198.51.100.77 against the local Administrator account looks like a brute-force intrusion vector but is unrelated benign scanner noise (no success, IP is rated benign in threat intel). A correct agent must NOT attribute the compromise to this and must self-correct.
